---
name: Using Mininet-IPLab in a course
about: Tell us you teach with it, or plan to, and what you need
labels: course
---

## Your course

What you teach (topic, level), roughly how many Learners and Groups, and
whether it is a lab session, an exam or self-study.

Issues are public: leave out student names or anything your institution
would not publish.

## How you run it

The host (CPU, memory, OS or VM) and the mode: one Lab per person
(`--enable-web`), one shared Lab (`serve`), or one Lab per Group
(Multi-Lab Mode).

## What you need

Questions, missing Lab Examples or features, or anything that got in the way.

## How it went

Optional, after a class: what worked and what did not.
